description: Bundle optimization via Vite manual chunks to split the 1.5MB index chunk into manageable vendor bundles
steps: Modify vite.config.ts: add build.rollupOptions.output.manualChunks function that splits: vendor-react (react, react-dom, react-router-dom), vendor-ui (@radix-ui packages, framer-motion, class-variance-authority, clsx, tailwind-merge), vendor-firebase (firebase packages), vendor-charts (recharts), vendor-livekit (livekit-client, @livekit/components-react), vendor-supabase (@supabase/supabase-js)
Run npm run build and verify the main chunk is significantly smaller and vendor chunks are created
Verify no runtime errors by checking the build output has no errors
acceptance_criteria: Main index chunk is significantly smaller than 1503KB
Vendor-react, vendor-ui, vendor-firebase, vendor-charts, vendor-livekit, vendor-supabase chunks exist in dist/assets/
No chunk exceeds 600KB (the new warning limit)
verification: Run: source /root/.nvm/nvm.sh && cd /projects/sandbox/Parallaxai && npm run build 2>&1 | grep -E '(vendor|index-).*\.js'
Run: source /root/.nvm/nvm.sh && cd /projects/sandbox/Parallaxai && npm run test
